$schema: this file has no external schema — see FetchBundledAssetsTask.kt's doc comment for the shape a parser accepts
note: Single source of truth for every asset the app ships bundled (D35, D36; FR-AST-3/3a/3b).
buildSrc's FetchBundledAssetsTask reads this file at build time to fetch, verify and package
app/src/main/assets/bundled/ (gitignored). app's ModelCatalog (ModelsViewData.kt) is generated
from this same file at build time (see ort.android-app.gradle.kts's generateBundledAssetCatalog
task) so the app and the build agree by construction — see WPG's build report for why a
generated Kotlin object was chosen over a runtime resource read.
destination is the path under the app's private filesDir the existing locators already read
(AsrModelLocator.modelsDir, SileroVadLocator.modelFile) — copied verbatim from those, not
reinvented here, so nothing drifts.
sha256 is either a genuine, sourced 64-hex digest, or the literal string
'trust-on-first-fetch' for an asset with no published digest anywhere (see tiny.en-tokens.txt's
history below) — FetchBundledAssetsTask computes the real digest on first fetch and rewrites
this field in place, so every later build verifies against a real, pinned value. That already
happened once for tiny.en-tokens.txt (see its own comment) — no entry below still reads
'trust-on-first-fetch' as committed, but the task supports encountering one.
tiers lists which device tiers (core/PassId.kt's Tier: T0..T3) may ever load this asset — every
asset still ships on every install (FR-AST-3: one build variant), tiers only governs whether
ModelsController reports a row as tierEligible so the UI can say 'stored, not loaded' honestly
(FR-AST-3a, AC-138) — it is never used to skip packaging an asset.
gated: true means the source repository requires accepting a licence on HuggingFace and an
Authorization: Bearer <HF_TOKEN> header to fetch — FetchBundledAssetsTask fails the build
naming the one-line fix when HF_TOKEN is absent for such an entry, unless the local-dev-only
escape hatch is set (see that task's doc comment).

assets._sha256Note: Computed 2026-09-10 by WPG (buildSrc/FetchBundledAssetsTask's own build report) from a real fetch of this exact URL — unlike the other entries' digests, which were read from published metadata without downloading. HuggingFace publishes no sha256 for this specific, non-LFS-tracked file (ModelsViewData.kt's ModelCatalog KDoc has the full account) — this is the trust-on-first-fetch value FetchBundledAssetsTask would have pinned itself the first time it ran; obtaining it directly here avoids every future build needing network access for one small text file whose upstream bytes are static.
